tr.subtitle: 3B ve retro futbol oyna
tr.promotionalText: Topu sen sür, şutu sen çek: 3B stadyumda 11'e 11 maç ya da yukarıdan bakışlı retro Klasik. 28 lig, 32 milli takım, kupalar ve her hafta güncellenen kadrolar.
tr.description:
Kaptan Mecit, maçı senin oynadığın bir futbol oyunu: parmağınla oyuncunu koşturur, pas verir, çalım atar, kafaya çıkar ve şutu kendin çekersin. Üç boyutlu stadyumda 11'e 11 oyna ya da yukarıdan bakışlı, piksel çizimli retro Klasik görünümü seç.

Sahada top ayağına yapışık gider; rakibin önünde sert yön değiştirip çalım at, yüksek ortada kafaya çık, şuttan önce son adımı at ve köşeye gönder. Kaleci zamanında uzanır, yakaladığı topu elinde tutar. Gol olunca tribünler ayağa kalkar, golcü köşe bayrağına koşar, gol ağır çekimde tekrar edilir.

• Modern: 3B stadyum, yayın, taktik ve yakın kamera, gece / gün batımı / gündüz maçları, maç raporu ve gol tekrarı
• Klasik: yukarıdan bakışlı, piksel çizimli retro futbol; dik ya da yan tut
• Kafa Topu: büyük kafalı oyuncularla bire bir hızlı maç; kafa, vole ve güç vuruşları
• 28 lig, 496 kulüp ve 32 milli takım; kıta kupaları, Kıtalar Arası Kupa ve Milletler Kupası (8 grup, Son 16'dan eleme)
• Lig modu: kulübünü seç, her hafta kendi maçını oyna; puan durumu, fikstür, gol krallığı, rakip raporu, sezon seyri, ödüller, istatistikler, tarihçe
• Camia: başkanın sözü, taraftarın nabzı, haftanın manşeti, derbiler
• Düzenleme modu: kulüp ve oyuncu adlarını, renkleri, forma numaralarını değiştir; paketini arkadaşlarınla paylaş
• Kadrolar her hafta güncellenir
• 34 diziliş, oyun anlayışı (savunma / dengeli / hücum), takım konuşması, oyuncu değişikliği
• Faul, kart, penaltı, ofsayt, VAR, duran toplarda baraj
• Dokunmatik, klavye (WASD) ve Bluetooth oyun kolu
• Türkçe ve İngilizce; Rehber ve Nasıl Oynanır ekranı
• İnternetsiz oynanır; reklam yok, veri toplanmaz

Tüm kulüp ve oyuncu adları kurmacadır.

Bir Mr. Anduv! yapımıdır.
tr.whatsNew: Yeni mod: Kafa Topu. Açılışta Klasik ve Modern'in yanında üçüncü seçenek: büyük kafalı efsanelerle bire bir, kafa ve vole vuruşlu hızlı maçlar.

en.subtitle: Play 3D and retro football
en.promotionalText: You run with the ball, you take the shot: 11-a-side in a 3D stadium or the top-down retro Classic. 28 leagues, 32 national teams, cups and squads updated every week.
en.description:
Kaptan Mecit is a football game where you play the match yourself: run with your player using your finger, pass, beat your man, rise for headers and take the shots. Play 11-a-side in a 3D stadium or pick the top-down, pixel-art retro Classic view.

The ball stays at your feet; change direction sharply to feint past a defender, rise for headers from high crosses, plant your foot and pick your corner. Keepers dive on time and hold on to the ball they catch. When you score the stands erupt, your scorer runs to the corner flag and the goal is replayed in slow motion.

• Modern: 3D stadium, broadcast, tactical and close cameras, night / sunset / day matches, match report and goal replays
• Classic: top-down pixel-art retro football; hold your phone upright or sideways
• Head Ball: quick one-on-one matches with big-headed players; headers, volleys and power shots
• 28 leagues, 496 clubs and 32 national teams; continental cups, an Intercontinental Cup and a Nations Cup (8 groups, knockouts from the Round of 16)
• League mode: pick your club and play your own match every week; table, fixtures, top scorers, opponent report, season graph, awards, statistics, history
• Club life: the chairman's words, the fans' mood, headline of the week, derbies
• Edit mode: rename clubs and players, change colours and shirt numbers, share your pack with friends
• Squads updated every week
• 34 formations, playing style (defensive / balanced / attacking), team talks, substitutions
• Fouls, cards, penalties, offside, VAR, defensive walls at set pieces
• Touch, keyboard (WASD) and Bluetooth controllers
• Turkish and English; a Guide and a How to Play screen
• Plays offline; no ads, no data collection

All club and player names are fictional.

Made by Mr. Anduv!
en.whatsNew: New mode: Head Ball. A third choice next to Classic and Modern on the first screen: quick one-on-one matches with big-headed legends, headers and volleys.

inceleme_notu:
Kaptan Mecit is an action football game that the player controls in real time: you run with one player using touch (left half of the screen), pass, shoot, tackle and head the ball, and you play every match yourself. It has three modes in one app, chosen on the first screen after the language: Modern (11-a-side in a 3D stadium, Godot engine), Classic (top-down pixel-art 11-a-side) and Head Ball (a quick one-on-one side-view football mode added in 1.7.8).

Our other football app on the App Store, Champion Battle Manager, is a different product in a different genre: a football management simulation where the user never controls a player and only manages transfers, finances, staff and tactics while matches are simulated. Champion Battle Manager can show its simulated matches with the same 3D stadium renderer, but its users never control a player; Kaptan Mecit is the playable game and has no management economy (no transfers, finances or staff). Their gameplay, screens, menus and store pages are different.

This version replaces the 1.0.0 build that was reviewed earlier. Since then the game has been rebuilt: a full 3D match engine with headers, skill moves, goalkeeper dives, fouls, VAR and replays; 28 leagues, 32 national teams and cups; a league mode; an edit mode; Turkish and English; touch, keyboard and Bluetooth controller support. It was tested for weeks by our TestFlight and Google Play closed test groups.

How to test: choose a language, then Modern or Classic. In Modern tap Kick off; drag on the left half of the screen to run, use PASS and SHOOT. League / Cups opens the league and cup modes. No login, no ads, no in-app purchases, no data collection; the game works fully offline. All club and player names are fictional.
